label: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY - self-written for a synthetic demo. Not a coverage policy, not MCG or InterQual content, not clinically validated.
reference_date_rule: Time windows are measured back from the date of the provider's request letter.

status_rules.met: The record contains evidence that supports this part.
status_rules.not_met: The record contains evidence that contradicts this part.
status_rules.missing: The record does not address this part. Silence is never not_met.

rule_rollup: Computed in code, not by the model: any part not_met -> rule not_met; else any part missing -> rule missing; else all parts met -> rule met. Any met or not_met part without a verified quote -> rule unverified, routed to human review.

criteria.title: Low back pain with radicular symptoms is documented

elements.met_when: A clinical note describes low back or lumbar pain.
elements.not_met_when: A note states the patient has no low back pain.

elements.text: Radicular symptoms or signs are documented (pain, numbness, or weakness radiating into a leg, or a positive straight-leg raise).
elements.met_when: A note describes radiating leg symptoms or a positive radicular exam finding.
elements.not_met_when: A note states there are no radicular symptoms and a negative radicular exam.

criteria.title: At least 6 weeks of conservative treatment in the last 6 months, including an active component, with inadequate response

elements.text: Conservative treatment lasted at least 6 weeks.
elements.met_when: Dates or durations show 6 weeks or more of treatment.
elements.not_met_when: Dates or durations show less than 6 weeks of treatment in total.

elements.text: The treatment took place within the 6 months before the request date.
elements.met_when: Treatment dates fall within 6 months before the request letter date.
elements.not_met_when: All documented treatment ended more than 6 months before the request letter date.

elements.text: Treatment included an active component (physical therapy or a supervised or home exercise program).
elements.met_when: Physical therapy or an exercise program is documented as delivered.
elements.not_met_when: The record states the patient received only passive treatment such as medication or rest.

elements.met_when: A note documents persistent symptoms or limited improvement after treatment.
elements.not_met_when: A note documents that symptoms resolved or substantially improved.

criteria.title: No lumbar MRI or CT in the prior 12 months

elements.text: No lumbar spine MRI or CT was performed in the 12 months before the request date.
elements.met_when: The record explicitly states no prior lumbar imaging, or prior lumbar MRI/CT is dated more than 12 months before the request.
elements.not_met_when: The record documents a lumbar MRI or CT within 12 months before the request date.

criteria.title: The ordering clinician documents how the new imaging would change management

elements.text: The ordering clinician states how MRI results would change the treatment plan (for example, a planned injection, surgical consultation, or a specific decision that depends on the result).
elements.met_when: A note links the imaging result to a specific management decision.
elements.not_met_when: A note states that imaging will not change management.
